decision.explanation: Both answers are directly supported by the provided sources. From D2S13, William Rooke Creswell was appointed a Knight Commander of the Order of the British Empire (KBE) in 1911. From D1S4, he was presented with the Robert Falla Memorial Award at the Australian Museum. These are two distinct awards received by the same individual, and both are valid under the 'other' slot hint.
